audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 with Jayce carry threat 8/10 matches how the lane plays: he out-ranges everything until Quinn's level-6 roam tempo.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags its own chart: Quinn wins 57.33% over 757 games while the chart hands Jayce five of seven stages.
audit.why: The mirror (jayce__quinn) recorded no chart correction, so flipping rows from this side would create a disagreement mirror-fix would then overwrite. The conflict is a data question, not something the kits can settle.
audit.corrected: No chart edit — raised in questionsForUser. Real numbers added instead: Shock Blast 16s at rank 1, Thundering Blow 20s, weapon swap 6s, Vault 12s, Blinding Assault 11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings say you can 'Q-blind his hammer autos' or 'blank his hammer autos with Q'; the weapon-swap tell is absent.
audit.why: Blinding Assault marks an enemy and hinders its vision by Riot's text — it never stops an attack, so the late-game plan of blanking his hammer autos does not exist. The page is right that Q does nothing to his poke, but for the wrong reason. His R swap is the real burst tell: it is 6s and the first attack in Cannon stance shreds armour and MR, so the swap animation is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Replaced the blind claims with out-trading hammer stance, and named the swap as the burst tell with its 6s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Its full cooldown' with no number on the Thundering Blow don't.
audit.why: Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 — the longest window in his kit and the one that decides whether you can step up.
audit.corrected: Number written in, and the title now names the ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are written in the first person.
audit.why: Breaks the site's second-person coaching voice.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in second person at the same length.

edits.before: His acceleration-gate Q keeps chipping you while you can't punish — the blind is useless against his ability poke.
edits.after: His gated Shock Blast keeps chipping you while you can't punish — Blinding Assault hinders vision, it stops none of it.

edits.before: With a Collector/Galeforce window you E the gap and Q-blind his hammer autos — genuinely even in a side-lane skirmish.
edits.after: With a Collector/Galeforce window you Vault the gap and out-DPS hammer stance — genuinely even in a side-lane skirmish.

edits.before: Jayce's cannon Q acceleration-gate poke and E knockback out-range your Q blind ball, so he chips you before you can leap a Harrier auto.
edits.after: Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate out-ranges everything you have, so he chips you long before you can Vault in for a Harrier auto.

edits.before: Once you have a Collector/Galeforce window you can E-dash the gap and blank his hammer autos with Q to even a side-lane skirmish.
edits.after: Once you have a Collector/Galeforce window you can Vault the gap and out-trade hammer stance to even a side-lane skirmish.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1; his 6s weapon swap shreds resistances on its first hit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 — step up only once he has spent it.

edits.before: Land E knockback into hammer burst combo the moment you E in for a trade
edits.after: Land Thundering Blow into the hammer combo the moment you Vault in

edits.before: Jayce just out-ranges everything I want to do early. His cannon Q comes through the acceleration gate before my Q blind ball even crosses the wave, and the blind does nothing to his ability poke since the damage is all Q/E, not autos. I can't trade-leap a Harrier auto when he sits a screen back chipping me. Farm at max range, dodge the slow Q ball with W move speed, and never walk up into E knockback range for a CS.
edits.after: Jayce out-ranges everything you want to do early. Shock Blast arrives through the Acceleration Gate before Blinding Assault's 1025 even crosses the wave, and hindering his vision does nothing to poke that is all Q and E rather than autos. Farm at max range, use Heightened Senses move speed to dodge the slow orb, and never step inside Thundering Blow's 240 range for a single creep.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he keeps poking and I keep bleeding, so I stop dueling him straight. At 6 the lane flips in tempo: my R refreshes Harrier and turns me into a scout, so I shove and roam off a immobile Jayce who can't follow. I look for him overextending to poke the wave, then E-Vault onto him with W up — but if he has E knockback ready, I'm getting flung into a hammer combo, so only commit when his gate is on cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he keeps poking and you keep bleeding, so stop dueling him straight. At 6 the tempo flips: Behind Enemy Lines makes you a scout, so shove and roam off an immobile Jayce who cannot follow. Watch for him overextending to poke the wave, then Vault on with Heightened Senses up — but if Thundering Blow is ready you get flung into the hammer combo, so commit only after its 20s is spent.

edits.before: Straight up, this is his lane and his scaling — his poke just outvalues my squishy frame and he reclaims first-item hard with Eclipse/Manamune. My realistic out is the map: use R roam to make picks elsewhere and let plates/CS keep me even rather than trading into his gate. By the time I have a lethality/crit item I can E the gap and Q-blind his hammer autos to even a 1v1, but I can't let his poke decide the game before then.
edits.after: Straight up, this is his lane and his scaling — the poke outvalues your squishy frame and he reclaims the first-item window hard with Eclipse/Manamune. Your realistic out is the map: use R roams for picks elsewhere and let plates and CS keep you even rather than trading into the gate. With a lethality item you can Vault the gap and out-trade hammer stance, but never let his poke decide the game first.

notes: Chart deliberately untouched: the packet flags its own contradiction (57.33% for Quinn against a chart giving Jayce five stages) and the mirror recorded no chart correction, so any flip from this side would be a guess that mirror-fix would then arbitrate. See questionsForUser. Jayce's Q lists six cooldown values (16/14/12/10/8/6) because the two stances share the slot; I quoted rank 1 as 16s and did not imply the cannon and hammer forms share a timer beyond what the file shows.
